text:
A personal weekly digest of what the Australian government has been saying and doing in the digital and cyber policy realms, on various adjacent topics, and whatever else interests me, Stilgherrian.

Posted (nearly) every Friday afternoon.

Prior to the launch of The Weekly Cybers on 19 January 2024, I produced a roughly equivalent series of blog posts, Digital developments from Canberra.

This is not a cyber security newsletter. For that that I recommend Risky Biz News.
